preregistration.question: 2x2 factorial: architecture (GPU-native TE vs OV BF16 CPU TE) x client (per-request RunMonitor vs persistent RunMonitor); primary endpoint = actual 4-request batch wall (images/min = 240/wall)
preregistration.design: warm sessions; interleaved poll,fast batches within each session; 2 block(s) of (A session + C session), block>=2 reversed
preregistration.exclusion_rule: fatal technical failure only (server error / worker crash); batch retained marked failed; never performance-based
preregistration.reload_policy: 2 warmups in A sessions so the documented CLIP-eviction reload lands outside measured batches; any in-batch reload detected via node timings, reported in both primary and warm-resident views
preregistration.frozen: prompts/token IDs/seed/latent/DiT/VAE/scheduler/8 steps/cfg=1/1024px; workflows byte-identical to the P2 study (same helpers)
